questions.q: The present ages of Vijay and Ajay are in the ratio 2 : 6. After 9 years the ratio will be 23 : 51. What is Ajay's present age?
questions.why: Let the ages be 2k and 6k: (2k + 9)/(6k + 9) = 23/51 gives k = 7, so Ajay is 42. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: If TABLET is written as UCEPJZ in a certain code, how is SYMPTOM written in that code?
questions.why: In the code the 1st letter moves 1 place, the 2nd 2 places, the 3rd 3 places, and so on: SYMPTOM → TAPTYUT. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: Suresh walks 6 m North, then turns left and walks 6 m, then turns right and walks 2 m, then turns left and walks 2 m. Which direction is Suresh facing now?
questions.why: Follow each turn from the first direction: the last leg is towards the West. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: In a group of 90 people, 52 like cricket, 30 like football and 21 like neither. How many like only cricket?
questions.why: Both = 52 + 30 − (90 − 21) = 13; only cricket = 52 − 13 = 39. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: If 20 June 2020 was a Saturday, what day of the week was 20 June 2021?
questions.why: 365 days later; 365 mod 7 = 1, so count 1 day on from Saturday. GPSC-style practice item.
Middle digit = sum of outer digits (3 + 6 = 9 …); 4 + 7 = 11, not 2. GPSC CBRT, Dec 2024.

questions.q: If REASON is coded 5 and BELIEVED 7, what is the code for GOVERNMENT?
questions.why: Code = number of letters − 1: GOVERNMENT has 10, so 9. GPSC CBRT, Jun 2025.

questions.q: Six books (English, Hindi, Science, Computer, Maths, Sanskrit) have different page counts. Computer has fewer pages than only two books. English has more than Science but fewer than Sanskrit. Science is not the least. Sanskrit has fewer than Hindi. The third-lowest book has 28 pages. Sanskrit + Computer = 89 and Computer + English = 63. How many pages does Sanskrit have?
questions.why: Order: Hindi > Sanskrit > Computer > English (28) > Science > Maths. Computer = 35, Sanskrit = 54. GPSC CBRT, Apr 2024.

questions.q: In a group of 80 people, 51 like cricket, 26 like football and 20 like neither. How many like only cricket?
questions.why: Both = 51 + 26 − (80 − 20) = 17; only cricket = 51 − 17 = 34. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: Statements: I. India's tea exports this year are the highest ever, due to demand for quality tea in Europe. II. Demand for coffee in the domestic market has risen over the last two years.
opts: Statement I is the cause and statement II is its effect
Statement II is the cause and statement I is its effect
Both statements are effects of independent causes
questions.why: Each statement is itself an effect (of European demand and of domestic taste), and the two are unrelated. The official key says C. GPSC CBRT, Dec 2024.
